items.title: Type designers have created a free font that poisons AI
items.excerpt: Type designers have released ShieldFont, a free typeface engineered to corrupt AI model training on scraped text and imagery. A concrete craft-level response from the design/typography community to generative-AI data harvesting, giving designers a defensive tool against having their work ingested.

items.title: The Bull And Bear Case For Digital Design In The Age Of AI
items.excerpt: Andy Budd examines how AI is reshaping product design: the bull case gives designers greater autonomy and less need for permission to act, while the bear case exposes the skill gaps that autonomy makes harder to hide. A framing piece for how design roles and workflows shift as AI removes handoff friction.

items.title: Your people get AI. Get out of their way
items.excerpt: With every design org now reaching for the same AI tools, the argument is that the winners will be those willing to trust the practitioners who already understand them. A design-leadership / AX-adoption take on how teams should reorganize around AI rather than gatekeep it.
